entities.summary: The Reformed Church in Transcarpathia is a historic Calvinist church in Ukraine. It is the oldest Protestant church in the country, founded in the 16th century, and a significant part of the Hungarian-speaking ethnicity belong to this denomination. Reformed Church in Sub-Carpathia/ Reformed Church in Transcarpathia is a Christian denomination in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
